data.rationale: The proposal matches the true procedure (Careers, Openings, filter by country, team and time type, search, optionally open the job and apply) in the right order with the right filter parameters. It treats the final job open and apply as optional and names "job title" as a parameter instead of "action", so the target job and action are less precisely specified, but a browser automation could still be built from it.
